title: EFTA Release Framework & Document Architecture
summary: The House voted 427–1 (Rep. Clay Higgins sole dissent) on November 18, 2025; the Senate passed unanimously the same day. Trump signed it into law November 19, without reporters present, after reporting indicated he personally lobbied individual GOP members to oppose the bill but was outmaneuvered by bipartisan momentum. The Act required DOJ to release all files within 30 days.
content:
The DOJ ultimately released approximately **3.5 million pages, 2,000 videos, and 180,000 images** across multiple batches (December 19, 2025 through January 30, 2026). The DOJ gathered 6 million qualifying pages before filtering — approximately **half remain unreleased**.

### Dataset Breakdown

| Dataset | Size | Files | EFTA Range | Release Date | Contents |
|---------|------|-------|------------|-------------|---------|
| DS 1–7 | ~3.0 GB | 4,085 PDFs | EFTA00000001–00009664 | Dec 19, 2025 | FBI 302 interview summaries, Palm Beach police reports from 2005–2008 investigations |
| DS 8 | 10.67 GB | 10,593 PDFs + MP4s | EFTA00009676–00039023 | Dec 22, 2025 | Prison CCTV footage (MCC New York), grand jury testimony 2007/2019, Austrian passport alias, call logs, Bannon iPhone photo |
| DS 9 | ~179 GB | ~533,786 files | EFTA00039025–01262781 | Jan 30, 2026 | Private email correspondence — the main trove; internal DOJ memos on NPA; correspondence with high-profile individuals |
| DS 10 | ~79 GB | ~50,403 files | EFTA01262782+ | Jan 30, 2026 | 180,000 images + 2,000 videos from Epstein's properties; self-recorded footage; Bannon interview (~15 hrs); DOJ initially published unredacted nude images, later removed |
| DS 11 | ~26 GB | ~331,655 files | Various | Jan 30, 2026 | Financial ledgers, flight manifests, Little St. James logbooks, boat trip logs, Maxwell financial records, property records |
| DS 12 | 114 MB | 154 files | Up to ~EFTA02731785 | Jan 30, 2026 | Supplemental late-production set; downloadable at justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%2012.zip |

**Note on Dataset 9:** The DOJ pagination operates as an "infinite loop" — pages beyond approximately 13,000 contain no new documents. Community researchers flagged the dataset as **incomplete at source**.

### Repository Structure (Four Pillars)
- **Pillar I:** DOJ Disclosures — 3.5M pages across 12 datasets
- **Pillar II:** Court Records — specific case filings (Doe v. Indyke, Maxwell trial, etc.)
- **Pillar III:** House Oversight — 8,624 committee-released documents
- **Pillar IV:** FBI Vault/FOIA — pre-existing, heavily redacted releases

### Key Individual Mention Frequencies
- Lesley Groff: **157,613** (Epstein's personal assistant — second-most mentioned person after Epstein)
- Richard Kahn: **52,781** (accountant/estate manager)
- Trump/Melania/Mar-a-Lago: **38,000+** references across 5,300+ files (NYT analysis)
- Darren Indyke: **17,783** (Epstein's lawyer/will executor)
- Ghislaine Maxwell: **13,163**
- Les Wexner: **4,000+**
- Jean-Luc Brunel: **4,727**
- Sultan Ahmed bin Sulayem: **4,700+**
- Miroslav Lajčák ("Miro"): **788**

### Redaction Policy & Anomalies

The DOJ applied blanket visual redactions — every female depicted was treated as a potential victim — except Maxwell. Males were unredacted unless linked to a protected female. Critics note this policy simultaneously exposed at least **31 child victim identities** (failure to redact) and may have shielded perpetrators.

**Faulty redaction discovery:** Community researchers found that blacked-out text in some PDFs could be recovered by copy-pasting. Using this method, researchers recovered trust beneficiary names (EFTA01296151: Maxwell; EFTA01297516: both Brunel and Maxwell) and other content including an unverified FBI tip about Trump allegedly witnessing the killing of an infant born to a trafficking victim (explicitly labeled by DOJ as an "untrue and sensationalist claim submitted right before the 2020 election").

**Removed/missing documents:**
- EFTA00000468 — Photo of Trump, Epstein, Maxwell (removed December 20, 2025, restored after public outcry)
- EFTA01660679 — DOJ-compiled list of tips (removed)
- Three large video files removed: EFTA00276494.ts (4.3 GB), EFTA01244748.wmv, EFTA01244749.wmv
- Community-identified never-uploaded EFTA numbers: EFTA00709804–00709807, EFTA00770595, EFTA00774768, EFTA00823190–00823192, and others
- ~16 files disappeared from DOJ site after initial December 19, 2025 posting; CBS News identified the gap by comparing day-one and day-two releases

**DOJ O'Keefe recording (September 4, 2025):** James O'Keefe published a secret recording of DOJ acting Deputy Chief Joseph Schnitt, who stated: "They'll redact every Republican or conservative person in those files, leave all the liberal, Democratic people." Schnitt also said Maxwell's minimum-security prison transfer was "against BOP policy" and that AG Bondi "wants whatever Trump wants." DOJ said Schnitt had "no role in the Department's internal review."

**Democracy Defenders Fund** filed an OIG complaint and discovered DOJ "quietly altered previously released documents" — comparison on January 15, 2026 identified modified documents with additional redactions added post-publication.

title: The Trafficking Operation
summary: The files document a structured recruitment network: - Victims were paid $200 per girl they brought to Epstein; recruiter Haley Robson was told by Epstein "the younger the better" when she brought a 23-year-old - Epstein told one victim he "purchased" Nadia Marcinkova at age 15 from her family in Yugoslavia to be his "sex slave" - Ghislaine Maxwell ran recruitment alongside Epstein, with Sarah Kel
content:
### MC2 Modeling Agency (Jean-Luc Brunel)

Jean-Luc Brunel founded MC2 with up to **$1 million in Epstein funding** (name reportedly referenced E=MC² with "E" for Epstein). A former MC2 bookkeeper told the FBI in 2010 that Brunel flew in teenage models from around the world, housed them in Epstein's Upper East Side apartments, and **"loaned them out to wealthy clients for up to $100,000 a night."**

Brunel was in **secret cooperation negotiations** with federal prosecutors in 2016. His lawyer said Brunel had "recruited girls for Epstein and possessed incriminating photographs." A May 2016 email shows Epstein learned of the planned cooperation and alerted Kathy Ruemmler, claiming someone demanded "$3 million so that Jean Luc would not go in." Brunel went silent and was found hanged in a Paris prison on **February 19, 2022**.

### Scale of Victimization

The DOJ files documented:
- **32-to-60-count draft federal indictment** naming **19 victims** (Jane Doe #1 through #19), youngest described as 14; approximately 11 attended the same Palm Beach County school
- Palm Beach Police identified **27 girls and women aged 14–23** who visited Epstein's home for "massage services"; FBI grand jury testimony confirmed "more than a majority would have been under the age of 18"
- December 2019 **86-page SDNY co-conspirators prosecution memo** contained statements from **24 women abused as minors and 14 abused as adults**, evaluated for charges against Maxwell, Groff, and others

### Visa Applications & International Trafficking

Dataset 8 documents show Epstein served as point of contact for non-immigrant visa applicants from **Poland, Belarus, Ukraine, Russia, China, Croatia, and Slovakia** (2004–2005). American Express records (exclusively reported by CBS) revealed hundreds of Amex Black Card travel bookings arranging international flights for women and girls from Russia, Poland, Belarus, Latvia, and Ukraine between 2012 and 2019 — well after his conviction.

A wire transfer of **330 gallons of sulfuric acid** (six 55-gallon drums) was made December 6, 2018 — the same day SDNY reportedly opened its new federal investigation. DOJ files also contain anonymous allegations of **bodies buried at Zorro Ranch** (unverified).

### Virginia Giuffre

The most extensively documented victim. Recruited by Maxwell at age 16 at Mar-a-Lago. She described being trafficked to Prince Andrew (three occasions, including documented flight logs and the authenticated photo developed March 13, 2001 at a Florida Walgreens), Jean-Luc Brunel, **Glenn Dubin** ("Ghislaine told me to go to Glenn Dubin and give him a massage, which means sex"), Marvin Minsky, Bill Richardson, and others.

Giuffre died by **suicide on April 25, 2025**, at age 41 at her farm in Western Australia. She was 16 when recruited from Mar-a-Lago. Her posthumous memoir "Nobody's Girl" (October 21, 2025) described meeting Trump at Mar-a-Lago ("Trump couldn't have been friendlier"), offering to help her find babysitting jobs; **the memoir contains no allegations of wrongdoing by Trump.**

Regarding Trump, in a 2016 deposition (*Giuffre v. Maxwell*): "Have you ever been in Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein's presence with one another?" — **"No."** "Did you ever see Donald Trump at Jeffrey's home?" — **"Not that I can remember."** "Donald Trump never flirted with me." "I don't think Donald Trump participated in anything… I never saw or witnessed Donald Trump participate in those acts." — This remains the **strongest exculpatory evidence** regarding Trump.

Her death removed the possibility of further testimony. Her family expressed shock at Trump's July 2025 statement that Epstein "stole" Giuffre from his spa; they said "she wasn't stolen, she was preyed upon at his property."

### Mogilevich Organization Context

The FBI's 1996 Mogilevich intelligence report documents an extensive prostitution and human trafficking operation spanning Central Europe. Mogilevich runs prostitution operations out of the Black and White Nightclubs in Prague and Budapest — documented by foreign law enforcement as the "centerpiece of his operations in Europe." Russian women are recruited in Kiev and Moscow, provided cover jobs by Alexei Alexandrov, and placed in the market. Bodyguards are provided by Mogilevich and underboss Vitaly Savalovsky. The operation intersects with broader trafficking patterns documented in the Epstein files, sharing characteristics of cross-border recruitment, placement in entertainment venues, and protection by organized crime structures.

content:
### Flight Records

A January 2020 email from an SDNY prosecutor (released in December 2025 DOJ batch): **"the flight records we reflect that Donald Trump traveled on Epstein's private jet many more times than we previously had reported or that we were aware of."** Document EFTA00016732.

Federal records document at least **8 flights between 1993 and 1996**:
- May 15, 1994: Palm Beach → Teterboro via D.C. — with Marla Maples and infant Tiffany Trump
- August 13, 1995: Palm Beach → Teterboro — with Eric Trump and Maxwell
- January 5, 1997: Palm Beach → Newark
- One 1993 flight: only Trump and Epstein listed as passengers
- Maxwell was present on at least four flights

All documented flights were **domestic routes** — no evidence places Trump on flights to Little St. James. Pilot Larry Visoski confirmed Trump as a passenger during Maxwell trial testimony in December 2021. **Trump's 2024 statement:** "I was never on Epstein's Plane."

### The "Knew About the Girls" Emails

Three pivotal emails released by House Oversight Committee Democrats (November 12, 2025):

**Email 1 (April 2, 2011, Epstein to Maxwell):** "I want you to realize that that dog that hasn't barked is trump.. [VICTIM] spent hours at my house with him,, he has never once been mentioned. police chief. etc. im 75% there." Maxwell replied: "I have been thinking about that." House Republicans identified the redacted victim as Virginia Giuffre — who did not accuse Trump in her sworn testimony.

**Email 2 (January 31, 2019, Epstein to Michael Wolff):** "[Victim] mara lago. [identifier]. Trump said he asked me to resign, never a member ever. Of course he knew about the girls as he asked ghislaine to stop." This is the most widely covered email in the releases. FactCheck.org noted it "could be interpreted multiple ways" and doesn't specify if Epstein was referring to underage girls or definitively show Trump had knowledge of criminal activity.

**Email 3 (December 2015, Wolff to Epstein):** Wolff advised Epstein on how to exploit Trump's potential denials for "valuable PR and political currency" — "if he says he hasn't been on the plane or to the house, then that gives you a valuable PR and political currency. You can hang him in a way that potentially generates a positive benefit for you." CNN planned to ask Trump about Epstein at a debate but did not ask the question.

Additional emails from the same November 2025 release (House Republicans, 23,000 pages): A **2018 Epstein email** stating "I am the one able to take him down" (referring to Trump); a **2017 email to Larry Summers**: "I have met some very bad people, none as bad as trump. Not one decent cell in his body."

### Fifth Amendment Exchange

The deposition occurred **March 17, 2010**, in *Edwards v. Epstein*. When asked: "Have you ever socialized with Donald Trump in the presence of females under the age of 18?" Epstein responded: "Though I'd like to answer that question, at least today I'm going to have to assert my Fifth, Sixth, and 14th Amendment rights, sir." Epstein invoked the Fifth over **1,000 times** across his depositions, including about Clinton, Prince Andrew, and Maxwell. A 34-second clip went viral in July 2025.

Court record quote: *"...conceivably it would be the same response in Mr. Trump's situation, as the proprietor of Mar-a-Lago, there could be numerous occasions where Mr. Epstein may have been an invited guest and Mr. Trump's own daughters, who may have been under the age of 18 at the time, were also invited guests..."* ([EFTA00800982](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%209/EFTA00800982.pdf))

### The Mar-a-Lago Ban — Four Competing Narratives

Four distinct accounts exist for why Epstein was removed from Mar-a-Lago:
1. Real estate dispute over Maison de l'Amitié in 2004
2. 18-year-old beautician complaint in 2003
3. Harassment of a club member's teenage daughter at the pool circa October 2007 (when Mar-a-Lago records show Epstein's account "closed")
4. Trump's July 2025 claim that Epstein "stole" spa employees

Epstein's own email contradicts Trump's narrative: "Trump said he asked me to resign, never a member ever." A 2009 email summarizing a call with Brad Edwards quoted Trump saying Epstein "was not a member of his club at Mar-a-Lago, but he was a guest, and he had never been asked to leave."

**Brad Edwards (victims' attorney)** stated Trump was "the only person" among Epstein's associates who cooperated voluntarily: "the only person who, in my experience, worked with us, was Donald Trump" — calling Trump "very helpful."

**July 2006:** Per FBI interview with Palm Beach Police Chief Michael Reiter (October 2019), Trump called Reiter saying: "Thank goodness you're stopping him, **everyone has known he's been doing this.**" Trump also told Reiter Maxwell was Epstein's "operative" and "evil." This is significant because in July 2019, Trump told reporters he "had no idea" about Epstein's conduct.

### Accusers & Allegations Involving Trump

**The "Jane"/Interlochen victim:** Court documents describe a girl taken to Mar-a-Lago in **1994 when she was approximately 14**. Recruited by Epstein at Interlochen Center for the Arts. In her FBI 302, she stated Epstein introduced her to Trump, and Epstein "elbowed Trump playfully, asking him, 'This is a good one, right?'" Trump "smiled and nodded." She testified at Maxwell's 2021 trial (as "Jane") but **did not describe inappropriate behavior by Trump**. Her FBI interview was temporarily removed from the DOJ database; her mother's interview — recalling hearing "a prince and DONALD TRUMP visited EPSTEIN's house" — remains offline.

**~1983 accuser:** An FBI memo from the January 30, 2026 release detailed a woman's claim that around 1983, when she was approximately 13, Epstein introduced her to Trump, "who subsequently forced her head down to his exposed penis which she subsequently bit. In response, Trump punched her in the head and kicked her out." The FBI interviewed this accuser **four times**. Only the first interview (July 24, 2019) is in the public database, and it does not mention Trump. Of 15 documents listed in Maxwell case discovery for this accuser, only 7 are publicly available. **53 pages of interview documents appear to be missing** (NPR, February 24, 2026). Her attorney said she "was concerned about implicating additional individuals, and specifically any that were well known, due to fear of retaliation."

**Maxwell "presented" a victim to Trump:** A 2021 FBI memo described an Epstein victim who told investigators Maxwell once "presented" her to Trump at a party in New York, with Maxwell saying: "Oh I think he likes you. Aren't you lucky." The FBI memo noted it was "set up very much like how Maxwell introduced her to Epstein." The woman told investigators **"nothing happened"** between her and Trump.

**Stacey Williams (October 2024):** Former Sports Illustrated swimsuit model alleged Trump groped her when Epstein brought her to Trump Tower in the early 1990s. "I felt so humiliated and so sick to my stomach." She said Epstein talked about Trump "every time we spoke" and that Trump sent her a handwritten postcard: "Stacey — Your home away from home. Love Donald."

**The "Katie Johnson" / Jane Doe Lawsuit:** Three filings in 2016; withdrawn November 4, 2016 (six days before the election) after plaintiff received threats. The suit alleged rape by Trump and Epstein in 1994 when plaintiff was 13. Attorney Cheney Mason told journalist Tara Palmeri in 2025 he "still insists she told the truth." Michael Cohen confirmed Trump dispatched him to "take care of it." Credibility note: promotion of the case traced to "Norm Lubow," former Jerry Springer producer; Julie K. Brown said "the woman just wouldn't talk." FBI complaint form in January 2026 release is consistent with the lawsuit.

**NPR investigation (February 24, 2026):** Reporter Stephen Fowler found more than **50 pages of FBI interviews and notes** from conversations with women who accused Trump of sexual abuse as minors have been withheld from the public database despite the EFTA mandate. Identified through systematic serial number analysis.

### Trump Administration Officials Named in Files

- **Tom Barrack** (U.S. Ambassador to Turkey): 100+ text/email exchanges with Epstein from at least 2009 through 2018. Epstein regarded Barrack as a "potential conduit for passing information to Mr. Trump," with Barrack replying "on the bosses list" in one exchange. Epstein forwarded Barrack the "Katie Johnson" lawsuit email in April 2016. On August 29, 2016, a lunch was listed with Barrack, Ehud Barak, and Russian UN Ambassador Vitaly Churkin; **the day after, Epstein purchased approximately $1 million in Colony Capital stock** (Barrack's company). After Trump's election, a senior Saudi official texted Epstein asking about protocol for King Salman to call Trump; Epstein replied: "TOM barrack is your point person."
- **Howard Lutnick** (Commerce Secretary): Co-signed business documents with Epstein for a company called **Adfin** in December 2012, contradicting his public claim of cutting ties in 2005. Confirmed December 23, 2012 island lunch. Epstein's assistant forwarded Lutnick documents about casino legislation in the U.S. Virgin Islands. Faces bipartisan calls for resignation.
- **Steve Feinberg** (Deputy Defense Secretary): Named/correspondence in files.
- **John Phelan** (Navy Secretary): Named/correspondence in files.
- **Alexander Acosta** (Labor Secretary): Led the controversial 2008 non-prosecution agreement (see Section 14).
- **Steve Bannon** (Chief Strategist): See Section 5.

### Trump's Public Statements Timeline

- **July 2006:** Called Palm Beach Police Chief Reiter: "Thank goodness you're stopping him, everyone has known he's been doing this."
- **2009:** Cooperation with Brad Edwards; described Epstein as "not a member" but noted "he had never been asked to leave."
- **July 2019 (post-arrest):** "I had no idea" about Epstein's conduct; called him "not a friend" and said he "had a falling out with him a long time ago."
- **July 12, 2025:** Defended AG Bondi and called Epstein "somebody that nobody cares about."
- **July 16, 2025:** Called the files "a big hoax."
- **July 28, 2025 (Scotland):** Shifted explanation for banning Epstein: "He stole people that worked for me."
- **November 14, 2025:** Asked about the "knew about the girls" email: "I know nothing about that."
- Truth Social posts: Called the case "the Jeffrey Epstein Hoax" and wrote "My PAST supporters have bought into this 'bull—t,' hook, line, and sinker. I don't want their support anymore!"
- **October 2025 (Oval Office):** On a possible Maxwell pardon: "I haven't heard the name in so long... I'd have to take a look at it."

### Trump's Legal Actions

- **July 18, 2025:** Filed **$10 billion defamation lawsuit** against Dow Jones, News Corp, Rupert Murdoch, and two WSJ reporters over the **birthday letter story** (see Section 16). WSJ filed to dismiss in September 2025, arguing the article is true — Epstein's estate produced the birthday book. The House Oversight Committee released the actual letter in September 2025, confirming WSJ's reporting. Case pending as of late 2025.
- **September 15, 2025:** Filed **$15 billion lawsuit** against the New York Times, Penguin Random House, and four reporters. Judge Merryday dismissed the initial complaint as "tediously and burdensomely" improper September 19; Trump refiled within 28 days.

### Trump's Black Book Entry

Epstein's black book listed Trump with **16 phone numbers** — one of the highest counts — including emergency, car, security guard, and houseman numbers. His was among **five names circled or highlighted**. Also listed: Ivana Trump, Ivanka Trump, Robert Trump, Blaine Trump, and Melania (listed as "Milania").

### Mogilevich Organization Context

The Ryan Middleton connections map documents how the Mogilevich Organization's presence in Trump Tower predates and parallels Epstein's social connections to Trump. David Bogatin (key Mogilevich member) purchased 5 Trump Tower condos — all seized for money laundering. Vyacheslav Ivankov (Mogilevich lieutenant, "most influential Eurasian criminal") operated from Trump Tower with Trump Organization phone numbers. Felix Sater, son of Mogilevich syndicate boss Mikhail Sheferovsky, served as "Senior Adviser to Donald Trump" and co-developed Trump SoHo through Bayrock Group. Attorney Roy Cohn bridged Trump to the Five Families (Gambino, Genovese), while Manafort's connection to Firtash (who admitted Mogilevich association to the U.S. Ambassador) created another channel between the Trump orbit and Eurasian organized crime.

**10:39 PM (August 9):** An **"orange-colored figure"** was captured on the single working camera moving up the staircase toward Epstein's locked tier. The FBI described it as "possibly an inmate." The DOJ Inspector General identified it as an "unidentified corrections officer" carrying orange linen. Guard Noel told investigators she **never distributed linen.** Guard Ghitto Bonhomme (identified first by CBS) said he could not remember the period between 10 PM and midnight. Neither officer was specifically asked about the orange figure. The figure's identity **has never been determined**.

**August 10, 2019:**
- Guards Thomas and Noel failed to conduct required 30-minute checks, allegedly sleeping and browsing the internet
- Failed mandatory counts at **3 AM and 5 AM**
- At approximately **6:30 AM**, officer Michael Thomas discovered Epstein suspended from the top bunk by a homemade noose, legs straight out, buttocks roughly 1 to 1.5 inches off the floor
- Internal BOP memos describe Epstein as "cold" with "no palpable pulses"
- FBI agents did not arrive until **1:35 PM** — more than seven hours after the body was found
- Senior members of AG Barr's staff arrived at MCC — described as "highly unusual"; one source said in 20+ years they had never seen AG senior staff investigate an inmate death
- A **whiteboard video at 5pm the same day** ([EFTA00033221](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%208/EFTA00033221.mp4))

### Surveillance Footage

The DOJ released **419 MCC surveillance recordings** totaling approximately 412.5 hours across five camera positions in the 9 South Special Housing Unit. Of the **11 cameras** in the Special Housing Unit, **10 were not recording** due to malfunctioning hard drives.

Key footage: [EFTA00028842](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%208/EFTA00028842.mp4) — community analysis shows camera C-B14, labeled "J Epstein," capturing a figure in orange prison clothing on the cell floor at **4:29 AM on August 10, 2019** — roughly two hours before the body was officially discovered.

The released video was **processed through Adobe Premiere Pro** — not raw DVR output — with cursor and menu artifacts indicating it was a screen recording. A one-minute gap appears from 11:58:59 PM August 9 to midnight August 10. The FBI later acknowledged possessing a complete version without this gap. Most critically, the FBI **destroyed its master copy** (evidence item 1B60) of surveillance video in June 2024 after an agent obtained authorization, describing it as "no longer pertinent" — before the Transparency Act mandated disclosure. Had to reconstruct from screen-capture in mid-2025.

The full surveillance footage schedule ([see epstein_research.html Section 1.1](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%209/EFTA00064603.mp4) et seq.) covers July 18 through August 12, 2019, across multiple angles.

### Autopsy & Contested Medical Evidence

Autopsy performed by **Dr. Kristin Roman** (then Deputy Chief Medical Examiner). Initially listed manner of death as **"pending."** Chief Medical Examiner **Dr. Barbara Sampson** upgraded the ruling to suicide on August 16 after reviewing undisclosed "additional investigative information." Dr. Barbara Sampson stands firmly behind the suicide ruling.

**Dr. Michael Baden** (present at the autopsy, hired by Epstein's brother Mark): documented fractures of both superior horns of the thyroid cartilage and the left hyoid bone — each with hemorrhage (**three fractures total**). In 50+ years and 1,000+ jail hangings, Baden said he had **"never seen three fractures"** in a suicidal hanging. Additional concerns:
- The **ligature furrow mark** was in the middle of Epstein's neck rather than beneath the jawbone as expected in hanging
- The noose depicted in the autopsy **"doesn't match the ligature furrow mark"** — it was wider
- No blood transfer appeared on the cloth
- **Petechiae** (burst capillaries) on the face, mouth, and eyes were more consistent with strangulation
- Baden concluded the evidence pointed "much more to murder and strangulation than suicide"

### Cell Scene Evidence Issues

- **No evidence markers** in cell scene photographs
- Items **moved between photos**
- At least **two different nooses** found in different rooms
- No fingerprint or DNA tests conducted on anything in the cell
- Former NYPD detective Herman Weisberg described the scene as "staged a bit"; CBS forensic analyst called it "an absence of work"

Documents:

- [EFTA00063517](https://www.justice.gov/epstein/files/DataSet%209/EFTA00063517.pdf) — Autopsy photos (2)

title: Eurasian Organized Crime — The Mogilevich Organization
summary: FBI intelligence report on Semion Mogilevich's multinational criminal organization based in Budapest, Hungary. Numbering approximately 250 members, the organization operates across Central Europe, the United States, United Kingdom, Israel, and beyond. Principal activities include weapons trafficking, nuclear materials trafficking, prostitution, drug trafficking, dealing in precious gems, art theft, extortion, counterfeiting, and money laundering through a network of front companies anchored by Arigon Ltd. (Channel Islands).
content:
## Organization Overview

The Semion Mogilevich Organization, identified by a 1994 multinational law enforcement working group in Moscow, is a primarily European-based organized crime group engaged in a wide variety of criminal activities. Based in Budapest, Hungary, the organization numbers approximately 50–250 members and operates across Central Europe — Prague, Vienna, Moscow — with tentacles reaching the United States, Ukraine, United Kingdom, France, Israel, and beyond.

Mogilevich began his criminal career in the 1970s with the Lyuberts Mafia group in Russia, engaging in petty crimes and counterfeiting. In the early 1980s, he became affiliated with the Solntsevskaya Organization and profited from the organization of Jewish emigration from Russia, helping emigres smuggle assets out in exchange for fees. After a year in Poland, he moved to Budapest in 1989 and rapidly built a criminal empire.

## Financial Infrastructure

The center of the Mogilevich Organization's financial operations is **Arigon, Ltd.**, registered in Alderney, Channel Islands, United Kingdom. Arigon deals extensively with Ukraine, selling oil products to the Ukrainian state railway administration (Ukrzaliznytsa), selling clothing to the FSU, and holding exclusive rights to insure tourists traveling to Ukraine. Through Arigon, Mogilevich reportedly laundered over $30 million from Europe into the United States. Arigon uses bank accounts in Stockholm, London, New York City, and Geneva.

In the United States, the primary front companies are **FNJ Trade Management Corporation** in Los Angeles, California, and **YBM Magnex, Inc.** in Newtown, Pennsylvania. Bank records revealed 45 wire transfers between January 1993 and April 1995 — 23 transactions to Arigon, and FNJ received 11 payments totaling $748,500 from Arigon. YBM Magnex claimed net sales of $32.5 million and $17.5 million in stockholders' equity, yet surveillance revealed it occupied a small section of a former school building incapable of supporting its stated operations.

In 1993, Mogilevich used Arigon to obtain a 90% interest in **Army Co-op** (701 million forints), which then privatized the state-run **DIGEP machine factory** — making Mogilevich a direct owner of the Hungarian armaments industry. He also controls the **Balchug Group** (bank, furniture company, hotel/casino in Moscow), **Arbat International** (co-owned with Ivankov and Solntsevskaya), and numerous front companies across Europe and North America.

## Criminal Activities

### Weapons Trafficking & Nuclear Materials
Criminal groups under Mogilevich's domain in the Czech Republic are involved in trafficking illegal weapons, radioactive materials, and precious gems. In 1994, Mogilevich purchased a license enabling him to buy and sell weapons through Army Co-op and traditional Hungarian arms export companies.

### Prostitution & Human Trafficking
Mogilevich runs an extensive prostitution operation out of the Black and White Nightclubs in Prague and Budapest. Russian women are recruited in Kiev and Moscow, provided cover jobs, and placed in the market. Bodyguards are provided by Mogilevich and Vitaly Savalovsky.

### Art Theft & Trafficking
In early 1995, Mogilevich and the Solntsevskaya Organization established a joint venture to steal art from Russian churches and museums — including the Hermitage in St. Petersburg — for sale in the West via Budapest. Stolen antiques, including Faberge eggs, were to be "restored" in Budapest then shipped to London for sale through Sotheby's auction house. The Solntsevskaya claimed to have already shipped $3 million worth of antiques out of Russia.

### Drug Trafficking
The organization is indirectly linked to cocaine and heroin trafficking. In February 1994, Mogilevich placed calls from Warsaw to a Vienna number tied to known Cali and Medellin cartel traffickers. He reportedly purchased a bankrupt Georgian airline to facilitate heroin smuggling from Southeast Asia.

### Extortion
Mogilevich and the Solntsevskaya Organization shared proceeds in extortion schemes targeting Austrian businessman Julius Meinl ($50,000/month), financier Alexander Konanykhine, and businessman Andrei Mokhin ($375,000).

### Counterfeit Products
The organization produced 15 million bottles of illicit vodka per month, packaged in Absolut brand bottles, earning $1–2 million per truckload. In May 1995, Hungarian authorities confiscated 24,000 liters of fake Absolut destined for Ukraine.

### Murder
Mogilevich ordered the murder of businessman Oleg Shirokov. Vladimir Berkovich allegedly arranged contract murders through the Palm Terrace Restaurant in Los Angeles, importing hitmen from Russia on tourist visas. Enforcers in Prague were known for torture and stabbing rather than shooting.

## Links to Other Criminal Organizations

The Mogilevich Organization is tied to the **Vyacheslav Ivankov Organization** and the **Solntsevskaya Organization** through meetings, joint investments, and silent partnerships. Mogilevich allegedly secured Ivankov's early release from a Russian prison through payoffs and established over 100 front companies and bank accounts for Solntsevskaya. He also aided Monya Elson's escape from the U.S. after assassination attempts.

Contacts with the **Italian Camorra** (Giuliano clan, via Salvatore DeFalco) were established in Prague. Eduard Garmel met with individuals connected to the **Genovese La Cosa Nostra Family**. Links to **Colombian cartels** (Cali and Medellin) are evidenced through telephone intercepts.

## Police & Public Corruption

Mogilevich's corruptive influence extends to the Russian security services. In 1995, two colonels from Department P of the Russian Presidential Security Service traveled to Hungary under commercial cover to meet with Mogilevich, seeking political intelligence. Israeli associate Shabtai Kalmanovich provides Israeli passports in short order for Mogilevich and Solntsevskaya associates, suggesting Israeli government connections. Two former Hungarian policemen serve as security coordinators, and Mogilevich uses Czech intelligence informants for disinformation campaigns.

## Key Business Entities

Arigon Ltd. (Channel Islands) • YBM Magnex Inc. (Pennsylvania/Budapest) • FNJ Trade Management (Los Angeles) • Army Co-op (Budapest) • DIGEP Machine Works (Miskolc) • Balchug Group (London/Moscow/San Diego) • Arbat International (Moscow) • Black and White Nightclub (Prague/Budapest) • U Holubu Restaurant (Prague) • Palm Terrace Restaurant (Los Angeles) • Ritual Funeral Services (Moscow) • Independent Trade Union Bank (Moscow/Cyprus/Tel Aviv) • Neftanoy Bank (Moscow)

## Connections Map — Extended Network (Ryan Middleton Investigation)

### Trump Tower & Real Estate Nexus

David Bogatin, a key Mogilevich Organization member, purchased five condos in Trump Tower — all subsequently seized by the government for money laundering. Vyacheslav Ivankov, Mogilevich's lieutenant and the most influential Eurasian criminal of the era, lived at Trump Tower and possessed Trump Organization phone numbers. Felix Sater, whose father Mikhail Sheferovsky was a Mogilevich syndicate boss (FBI files), served as senior adviser to Trump and managing director of Bayrock Group, which co-developed Trump SoHo from offices on the 24th floor of Trump Tower.

### Bayrock Group — Russian Financing Pipeline

Bayrock Group, founded by Tevfik Arif (17 years in USSR Ministry of Commerce, KGB-linked), channeled Russian money into Trump projects. Bayrock received investment from Vnesheconombank (VEB, Putin-chaired supervisory board) and $50M from FL Group (Iceland). Felix Sater "brought the people up from Moscow." Kazakh billionaire Alexander Mashkevitch also funded Bayrock and was co-arrested with Arif on a yacht in Turkey in 2010.

### Five Families — Roy Cohn Bridge

Attorney Roy Cohn served as mob consigliere for both the Gambino and Genovese families while simultaneously representing both Fred and Donald Trump. In 1983, Cohn brokered a meeting between Trump and Fat Tony Salerno (Genovese boss), leading to S&A Concrete — a Genovese-Gambino joint venture — building Trump Tower and Trump Plaza. Fred Trump's earlier partnership with Willie Tomasello (Genovese/Gambino associate) established the pattern. Mogilevich's network connected to all Five Families through Russian OC expansion in the 1990s.

### Israel-Mossad-Maxwell Connection

Robert Maxwell, the British media mogul and Mossad agent, obtained Israeli passports for Mogilevich and his associates in the late 1980s. Maxwell's money laundering for Mossad became the model for transnational OC money movement. His daughter Ghislaine's later involvement with Jeffrey Epstein creates a chain: Epstein → Ghislaine Maxwell → Robert Maxwell → Mogilevich, connecting organized crime, intelligence agencies, and political figures. Anatoly Katrich, a senior Mogilevich operative, relocated to Israel after expulsion from the Czech Republic, placing an active arm of the organization in Israel during Netanyahu's political rise (PM 1996).

### Energy & Banking Network

Mogilevich controlled energy interests through RosUkrEnergo. The Bank of New York $10 billion laundering scheme involved Inkombank and Bank Menatep — Russian financial institutions tied to the Mogilevich-Solntsevskaya network. Wilbur Ross (Trump's Commerce Secretary) chaired the Bank of Cyprus, a major Russian money hub where Manafort transactions were flagged. Gazprom and Rosneft (both represented by Christopher Wray's firm King & Spalding) connect to the network through Firtash and Tillerson.

### Dead Investigators

Three investigators of the Mogilevich network are known to have died: Alexander Litvinenko (FSB defector, poisoned with polonium-210 in London, 2006 — testified about Mogilevich-Putin relationship), FBI agent Robert Levin (died under suspicious circumstances in Iran while investigating Mogilevich's enriched uranium deal), and Slovak journalist Ján Kuciak (murdered 2018 while probing Fico-Mogilevich-'Ndrangheta connections — triggered mass protests and PM resignation).
